summary: Portfolio-aware planning + commitment_type feature tested. Backend: 15/15 pytest passed (test_portfolio_aware_planning.py). Validates commitment_type defaults/validation on Goals/Projects/Tasks (POST+PUT, invalid=400), live LLM planning turn on a fresh conversation (assistant reply within ~15-25s, no <<<HYMN_PROPOSAL>>>/<<<END>>> markers leaked to UI content, time_commitments shape validated when present), materialize creates time_commitments with source_type='system', idempotency (re-materialize=400), server-side safety net in _materialize_proposal correctly SKIPS exclusive items (verified DB state pre/post — exclusive goal status=active, deadline unchanged), non-exclusive postpone correctly sets status=paused + new deadline. /api/portfolio/time-commitments reflects new rows. Frontend: verified CommitmentTypeToggle renders on /goals/add, /projects/add, /tasks/add with all 6 testIDs present (add-{goal,project,task}-commitment-{postponable,exclusive}); tap on 'Exclusive' visually toggles selection (screenshot confirmed).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' — appears repeatedly across screens. Non-blocking but noisy. Reference: any component using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius (likely /app/frontend/src/lib/theme.ts or per-screen StyleSheet definitions).

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — a component is still passing pointerEvents as a prop instead of via style. Non-blocking. Grep for `pointerEvents=` in /app/frontend/app and /app/frontend/src/components to locate.

action_items: Optional cleanup: replace deprecated 'shadow*' RN style props with 'boxShadow' to silence Metro warnings.
Optional cleanup: move remaining `pointerEvents=` prop usages onto `style.pointerEvents` (RN 0.79+ deprecation).
critical_code_review_comments: planning_engine._materialize_proposal correctly guards exclusive items via the `if (doc.get('commitment_type') or 'postponable') == 'exclusive': continue` safety net — this is the server-side backstop the review request asked for and it works.

server.py update_goal/update_project/update_task all validate commitment_type against COMMITMENT_TYPES and return 400 on garbage input; create_* silently normalize invalid values to 'postponable' (asymmetry — POST accepts and normalizes, PUT rejects). This is intentional per current code but worth flagging: a client sending {commitment_type: 'garbage'} on POST will get 201 with commitment_type='postponable' rather than a 400. Consider tightening POST to reject invalid values symmetrically.
planning_engine._read_context loads 'commitment_type' on other_goals/other_projects/target and passes it through to the LLM prelude — good, this is what makes the LLM able to honour exclusive items.

_split_message strips HYMN_PROPOSAL markers from any assistant message shape sent to the UI (_shape_message applies it before serialisation). Verified: no marker leakage in POST /messages response content.
